BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the official state question; adding a newsection to chapter 1.20 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature toencourage attention to the wonderful Washington wine industry.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 1.20 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The question "Red or white?" is hereby designated as the officialquestion of the state of Washington.
